MARCA.PROMESSA: From the till to the balance sheet, with nobody copying anything from one sheet to the next.

HEROI.SUBTITULO: Every sale at the counter deducts stock from the right warehouse, updates the average cost, lands on the customer's account and shows up on the management dashboard.
HEROI.ALT_CAPTURA: The ControlCore management dashboard, showing sales, margin and stock indicators.

PROBLEMA.TITULO: Four questions a spreadsheet cannot answer
PROBLEMA.SUBTITULO: It is not a lack of work, it is a lack of one place where everyone's work comes together. While the data lives in separate files, every answer needs someone to reconcile it by hand.

DORES.titulo: The till closed with a difference
DORES.texto: The operator counted, the amount does not match, and nobody knows whether it was change, a cash drop or a voided sale. The conversation ends in suspicion.
DORES.resposta: Every movement in the session is recorded with the time and the person responsible, so the close-out explains itself.

DORES.titulo: Short in one store, surplus in another
DORES.texto: The stock exists, but in the wrong warehouse. You find out when a customer asks and the product is not on the shelf.
DORES.resposta: Stock is kept per warehouse, with recorded transfers, so you can see where it is before buying more.

DORES.texto: The purchase price changed three times this quarter. What was the real cost of what you sold today? Nobody dares to say.
DORES.resposta: Weighted average cost recalculated at every goods receipt, so margin comes from the numbers, not from a guess.

DORES.titulo: The supplier says it was delivered
DORES.texto: The delivery note is signed, the invoice has arrived, but the quantity that came into the warehouse was different. The argument is left without a document.
DORES.resposta: Goods receipt checked line by line against the purchase order, with whatever is still pending in plain sight.

OPERACAO.SUBTITULO: These are not seven programs swapping files at the end of the day. It is the same information travelling along the chain, and each step already knows what happened in the one before.

NOS.frase: The order goes out with the agreed price and the agreed deadline.
It is checked line by line. Whatever is missing stays pending, not forgotten.
It goes into the right warehouse and the average cost is recalculated on the spot.
A transfer between warehouses leaves a trail on both sides.
The sale deducts stock and closes the session with the amount that was counted.
The purchase goes into the history and the credit limit of whoever bought.
Management sees the day's margin without asking anyone for a report.

MODULOS.TITULO: What is inside, in screenshots of the system itself

LISTA.descricao: Sales for the day, gross margin, products at risk of running out and the status of open tills, by store or across the whole business.
Sell by barcode or search, several payment methods on the same sale, receipts with sequential numbering and till sessions with checked opening and closing.
Products by category, stock per warehouse with weighted average cost, a history of every movement and an alert when it drops below the minimum.
Customer record with purchase history, a defined credit limit and the outstanding balance next to every sale on credit.
Every till shift with its opening amount, sales, cash drops and the difference at close, signed off by whoever counted.
Every creation, change and deletion is recorded with the author, the time and what changed. Nothing is erased.

MAYRA.SUBTITULO: "How much did we sell today at the downtown store?", "Which products are below the minimum?", "Create a new product at this price". She reads your company's data, and only your company's data.

PONTOS.texto: Looking things up is instant. Creating, changing or deleting first shows what she is about to do and waits for your yes.

PONTOS.titulo: She sees what your profile sees
PONTOS.texto: A till operator does not get through Mayra what they would not have access to on screen.
Whatever Mayra changes goes into the audit log like any other change, with the name of whoever made the request.

CONVERSA.PERGUNTA_1: Which products are below the minimum stock at the downtown store?
CONVERSA.RESPOSTA_1: Three products, all in the Main Warehouse:
CONVERSA.PERGUNTA_2: Create an order with the usual supplier to restock.

SEGURANCA.SUBTITULO: No certification badges: ControlCore does not hold ISO 27001 or SOC 2, and saying otherwise on a website would be a false statement about an audit that never took place. What follows is what the system does, and what you can verify.

GARANTIAS.titulo: Each company's data is kept separate
GARANTIAS.texto: Every query is filtered by the company of whoever makes it. Two companies on the same installation cannot see each other.

GARANTIAS.titulo: Nothing changes without leaving a record
GARANTIAS.texto: Creations, changes and deletions are saved with the author, the time and the previous values. The record cannot be edited.

GARANTIAS.titulo: Each profile sees what it is meant to
GARANTIAS.texto: Permissions are per profile and checked on the server, not merely hidden on screen.
Only the hash is kept. Recovery sends new credentials by email, and the old password only stops working once the email has been sent.

COMECAR.TITULO: One store at a time, not the whole company
COMECAR.SUBTITULO: Switching a chain's management system over a single weekend is how operations get lost. The way in is the opposite: prove it in one store and then expand.

PASSOS.texto: How many stores, how many warehouses, how many tills. You leave knowing whether the system is right for you, even if the answer is no.
Products, prices and current stock come in from the files you already have. Nothing is retyped by hand.
You start with one store and one till, running alongside what you use today. You only expand once the day's close-out matches.
The remaining stores join with the process already proven, and the team trained by the people who were in the first one.

FECHO.TITULO: Start with the question that goes unanswered today
FECHO.SUBTITULO: Bring yesterday's till close-out, or your last stock count. Half an hour is enough to see whether ControlCore has the answer, and to tell you if it does not.

PRECOS.TITULO: Three tiers. All of them give access to the whole platform.
PRECOS.SUBTITULO_ANTES: What changes between tiers is the
PRECOS.SUBTITULO_DEPOIS: , not a different system behind the scenes. Every plan runs on the same ControlCore.
